        "contents": "-- Tappka Authentication System Migration\n-- Creates tables for user profiles, teams, pre-registered emails, and verification codes\n\n-- Create role enum\nCREATE TYPE user_role AS ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Teams table (tymove firmy)\nCREATE TABLE teams (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    year INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (year &gt;= 1 AND year &lt;= 3),\n    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Profiles table (extends auth.users)\nCREATE TABLE profiles (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',\n    team_id UUID REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,\n    school_email TEXT,\n    locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cs' CHECK (locale IN ('cs', 'en')),\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Pre-registered emails table (admin-imported from Excel)\nCREATE TABLE pre_registered_emails (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    team_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    role user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',\n    full_name TEXT,\n    claimed_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Verification codes table\nCREATE TABLE verification_codes (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    school_email TEXT NOT NULL,\n    code TEXT NOT NULL,\n    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    used BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Indexes for performance\nCREATE INDEX idx_profiles_team_id ON profiles(team_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_email ON pre_registered_emails(email);",

        "contents": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\n   - User enters code to complete verification\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\n\n## Database Schema\n\n### Tables\n\n#### &#96;profiles&#96;\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: false |\n| school_email | TEXT | Yes | Verified school email |\n| locale | TEXT | No | Preferred language ('cs', 'en'). Default: 'cs' |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Registration time |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Last update time |\n\n#### &#96;teams&#96;\nTeam companies (tymove firmy)\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Team identifier |\n| name | TEXT | No | Team name |\n| year | INTEGER | No | Cohort year (1, 2, 3) |\n| is_active | BOOLEAN | No | Still active team? Default: true |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n#### &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96;\nAdmin-imported student list from Excel\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Record identifier |\n| email | TEXT (unique) | No | School email from Excel |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | No | Assigned team |\n| role | ENUM | No | Expected role |\n| full_name | TEXT | Yes | Name from Excel (optional) |\n| claimed_by | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | Yes | User who claimed this email |\n| claimed_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Yes | When claimed |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;",

        },
        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "export async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  // This is more reliable than nested selects with RLS\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1);\n\n  // Return false if query failed or no profiles found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if at least one profile exists\n  return Array.isArray(profiles) &amp;&amp; profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile with optional select fields\n * Uses RLS policy to ensure user can only see their own profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns The profile data if found, null otherwise\n */\nexport async function getCurrentUserProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient,\n): Promise&lt;Profile | null&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\n                          │ role (enum)     │\n                          │ removed_access  │\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\n                          │ created_at      │  │\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\n                                    ▲          │\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verification Logic\n\n- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",

        "contents": "ALTER TABLE verification_codes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n-- Teams: Anyone authenticated can read active teams\nCREATE POLICY \"Anyone can view active teams\" ON teams\n    FOR SELECT USING (is_active = true);\n\n-- Teams: Only admins can modify teams\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage teams\" ON teams\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Profiles: Users can read their own profile\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view own profile\" ON profiles\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);\n\n-- Profiles: Verified users can view other profiles in their team\nCREATE POLICY \"Verified users can view team profiles\" ON profiles\n    FOR SELECT USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles AS viewer\n            WHERE viewer.id = auth.uid()\n            AND viewer.is_verified = true\n            AND (\n                viewer.team_id = profiles.team_id\n                OR viewer.role IN ('coach', 'admin')\n            )\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Profiles: Users can update their own profile\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can update own profile\" ON profiles\n    FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id)\n    WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id);\n\n-- Profiles: Admins can manage all profiles\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage all profiles\" ON profiles\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Pre-registered emails: Users can check if their email exists\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can check pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);\n\n-- Pre-registered emails: Only admins can modify\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles ",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity: { provider: string }) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_email ON pre_registered_emails(email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_claimed_by ON pre_registered_emails(claimed_by);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_user_id ON verification_codes(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_school_email ON verification_codes(school_email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_expires_at ON verification_codes(expires_at);\n\n-- Function to handle new user signup\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, team_id, is_verified, locale, created_at, updated_at)\n    VALUES (\n        NEW.id,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n        COALESCE((NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role')::user_role, 'student'),\n        CASE \n         "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\n-- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere lower(trim(p.work_email)) = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.         "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email.       "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/api/verify/check-code/route.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 5
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 141,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    // Check if code matches\n    if (verificationCode.code !== code) {\n      // Increment attempts\n      await supabase\n        .from(\"verification_codes\")\n        .update({ attempts: verificationCode.attempts + 1 })\n        .eq(\"id\", verificationCode.id);\n\n      const remainingAttempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS - verificationCode.attempts - 1;\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        {\n          error: &#96;Neplatný kód. Zbývající pokusy: ${remainingAttempts}&#96;,\n        },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Code is valid! Mark as used\n    await supabase\n      .from(\"verification_codes\")\n      .update({ used: true })\n      .eq(\"id\", verificationCode.id);\n\n    // Get role and team from pre_registered_emails\n    const { data: preRegistered, error: preRegError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"pre_registered_emails\")\n      .select(\"role, team_id\")\n      .eq(\"email\", school_email.toLowerCase())\n      .single();\n\n    if (preRegError || !preRegistered) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to get pre_registered_emails:\", preRegError);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst data z registrace\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Update profile: set is_verified, school_email, role, and team_id from pre_registered\n    const { error: profileError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"profiles\")\n      .update({\n        is_verified: true,\n        school_email: school_email.toLowerCase(),\n        role: preRegistered.role,\n        team_id: preRegistered.team_id,\n      })\n      .eq(\"id\", user.id);\n\n    if (profileError) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to update profile:\", profileError);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se aktualizovat profil\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Claim the pre-registered email\n    await supabase\n      .from(\"pre_registered_emails\")\n      .update({\n        claimed_by: user.id,\n        claimed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n      })\n      .eq(\"email\", school_email.toLowerCase());\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      verified: true,\n\n}",

start_time),\n    \n    -- Prevent overlapping active reservations for the same room\n    CONSTRAINT no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (\n        room_id WITH =,\n        tstzrange(start_time, end_time) WITH &amp;&amp;\n    ) WHERE (status = 'active')\n);\n\n-- Cowork participants table\n-- Stores users who joined open cowork reservations\nCREATE TABLE cowork_participants (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    reservation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES reservations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    joined_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    \n    -- Each user can only join a reservation once\n    UNIQUE(reservation_id, user_id)\n);\n\n-- Room issues table\n-- Stores reported problems with rooms\nCREATE TABLE room_issues (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),",

        "contents": "/**\n * Coach dashboard for managing Training Sessions and schedule breaks\n * Only accessible by coaches and admins\n */\nexport default async function ReservationSettingsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is coach or admin\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n\n  if (profile?.role !== \"coach\" &amp;&amp; profile?.role !== \"admin\") {\n    redirect(\"/dashboard/reservations\");\n  }\n\n  const isAdmin = profile?.role === \"admin\";\n\n  // Fetch all data\n  const [roomsResult, schedulesResult, breaksResult, teamsResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Rooms that can have TS\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"can_have_ts\", true)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Recurring schedules with team info\n    supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .gte(\"valid_until\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"day_of_week\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .gte(\"end_date\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n\n    // Teams for TS assignment\n    supabase\n      .from(\"teams\")\n      .select(\"id, name, year\")\n      .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n      .order(\"year\")\n      .order(\"name\"),\n\n    // Room issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(50),\n  ]);\n\n  const rooms = (roomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const schedules = (schedulesResult.data || []) as (RecurringSchedule &amp; { room: Room; team: { id: string; name: string } })[];\n  const breaks = (breaksResult.data || []) as ScheduleBreak[];\n  const teams = teamsResult.data || [];\n  const issues = (issuesResult.data || []) as (RoomIssue &amp; {\n    room?: { id: string; code: string; name: string };\n    reporter?: { id: string; full_name: string };\n    resolver?: { id: string; full_name: string };\n  })[];\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

        "contents": "| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;\nTemporary codes for school email verification\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Code identifier |\n| user_id | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | No | Who requested |\n| school_email | TEXT | No | Email to verify |\n| code | TEXT | No | 6-digit code |\n| expires_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Code expiration (10-15 min) |\n| attempts | INTEGER | No | Failed attempts count. Default: 0 |\n| used | BOOLEAN | No | Already used? Default: false |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n### Database Trigger\n\nOn new user signup (auth.users insert), automatically create a profile record:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, is_verified, created_at, updated_at)\n  VALUES (\n    NEW.id,\n    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role', 'student'),\n    FALSE,\n    NOW(),\n    NOW()\n  );\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## UI Screens\n\n### 1. Landing Page (&#96;/&#96;)\n\nMinimal design with Tappka branding:\n- Tappka logo/name\n- Subtitle: \"Studentsky portal Tiimiakatemia\"\n- Login form (email, password)\n- \"Prihlasit se\" button (TAP Red)\n- \"Nemas ucet? Zaregistrovat se\" link\n- Language toggle (CZ/EN)\n\n### 2.                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\\n                          │ role (enum)     │\\n                          │ removed_access  │\\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\\n                          │ created_at      │  │\\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\\n                                    ▲          │\\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Verification Logic\\n\\n- **Unverified**: &amp;#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&amp;#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\\n- **Verified &amp;amp; Active**: &amp;#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **Access Revoked**: &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&amp;#96;\\n\\ [... omitted end of long line]"

        "contents": "/**\n * GET /api/reservations/[id]\n * Get a single reservation\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try {\n    const { id } = await params;\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { data: reservation, error } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name),\n        cowork_participants(\n          id,\n          user_id,\n          joined_at,\n          user:profiles(id, full_name)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"id\", id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (error || !reservation) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace nenalezena\" },\n        { status: 404 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data: reservation });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/reservations/[id] error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * PATCH /api/reservations/[id]\n * Update a reservation\n */\nexport async function PATCH(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\n\n/**\n * GET /api/reservations/[id]/participants\n * Get all participants of a cowork reservation\n */\nexport async function GET(\n  request: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: Promise&lt;{ id: string }&gt; }\n) {\n  try {\n    const { id } = await params;\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    // Check authentication\n    const {\n      data: { user },\n    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizovaný přístup\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    // Fetch participants with user info\n    const { data: participants, error } = await supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        id,\n        reservation_id,\n        user_id,\n        joined_at,\n        user:profiles!cowork_participants_user_id_fkey(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"reservation_id\", id)\n      .order(\"joined_at\", { ascending: true });\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching participants:\", error);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst účastníky\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data: participants });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"Participants API error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export default async function RoomDetailPage({ params }: RoomDetailPageProps) {\n\n\n  const [reservationsResult, issuesResult, alternativeRoomsResult, breaksResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Reservations for this room (past 7 days + next 14 days for calendar navigation)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"start_time\", oneWeekAgo.toISOString())\n      .lte(\"start_time\", twoWeeksLater.toISOString())\n      .order(\"start_time\"),\n\n    // Open issues for this room\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\")\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false }),\n\n    // Alternative rooms for suggestions\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .neq(\"id\", room.id)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks for the date range (past 7 + future 14 days)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .lte(\"start_date\", twoWeeksLaterStr)\n      .gte(\"end_date\", oneWeekAgoStr)\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n  ]);\n\n  const reservations = (reservationsResult.data || []) as Reservation[];\n  const issues = (issuesResult.data || []) as RoomIssue[];\n  const allAlternativeRooms = (alternativeRoomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const scheduleBreaks = (breaksResult.data || []) as ScheduleBreak[];\n\n  // Sort alternative rooms based on current room type\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\";\nimport {\n  OPERATING_HOURS,\n  MAX_ADVANCE_BOOKING_DAYS,\n  type CreateReservationInput,\n} from \"@/lib/reservations/types\";\nimport { isRoomAvailableOnDay } from \"@/lib/reservations/utils\";\nimport { getCurrentUserProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * GET /api/reservations\n * Fetch reservations with optional filters\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n    const roomId = searchParams.get(\"room_id\");\n    const startDate = searchParams.get(\"start_date\");\n    const endDate = searchParams.get(\"end_date\");\n    const userId = searchParams.get(\"user_id\");\n\n    let query = supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .order(\"start_time\");\n\n    if (roomId) {\n      query = query.eq(\"room_id\", roomId);\n    }\n\n    if query.eq(\"user_id\", userId);\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await query;\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching reservations:\", error);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst rezervace\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET         "contents": "/**\n * QR Code quick status page\n * Shows instant room availability status with split-screen colored design\n */\nexport default async function QRQuickStatusPage({ params }: QRPageProps) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Fetch room by code\n  const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"rooms\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (roomError || !room) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const nowIso = now.toISOString();\n\n  // Fetch current reservation\n  const { data: currentReservation } = await supabase\n    .from(\"reservations\")\n    .select(&#96;\n      *,\n      user:profiles(id, full_name),\n      team:teams(id, name)\n    &#96;)\n    .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n    .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n    .lte(\"start_time\", nowIso)\n    .gt(\"end_time\", nowIso)\n    .single();\n\n  // Fetch open issues\n  const { data: issues } = await supabase\n    .from(\"room_issues\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n    .eq(\"status\", \"open\");\n\n  const roomIssues = (issues || []) as RoomIssue[];\n  const isLocked = roomIssues.some((i) =&gt; i.issue_type === \"locked\");\n  const otherIssues = roomIssues\n    .filter((i) =&gt; i.issue_type !== \"locked\")\n    .map((i) =&gt; {\n      const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n        mess: \"Nepořádek\",\n        technical: \"Technický problém\",\n        other: \"Jiné\",\n      };\n      return labels[i.issue_type] || i.issue_type;\n    });\n\n  // Determine status\n  let status: 'free' | 'occupied' | 'locked' = 'free';\n  if (isLocked) {\n    status = 'locked';\n  } else if (currentReservation) {\n    status = 'occupied';\n  }\n\n  // Build response data\n  const quickStatusData = {\n    room: {\n      id: room.id,\n      code: room.code,\n      name: room.name,\n      description: room.description,\n    },\n    status,\n    issues: {\n      isLocked,\n      otherIssues,\n    },\n  };\n\n  // Add current reservation details if occupied\n  let currentReservationData = undefined;\n  let alternativeRooms = undefined;\n\n  if (currentReservation) {\n    const endTime = new Date(currentReservation.end_time);\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * GET /api/recurring-schedules\n * List recurring schedules\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"day_of_week\");\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching recurring schedules:\", error);\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst rozvrhy\" }, { status: 500 });\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/recurring-schedules error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Coach dashboard for managing Training Sessions and schedule breaks\n * Only accessible by coaches and admins\n */\nexport default async function ReservationSettingsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is coach or admin\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n\n  if (profile?.role !== \"coach\" &amp;&amp; profile?.role !== \"admin\") {\n    redirect(\"/dashboard/reservations\");\n  }\n\n  const isAdmin = profile?.role === \"admin\";\n\n  // Fetch all data\n  const [roomsResult, schedulesResult, breaksResult, teamsResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Rooms that can have TS\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"can_have_ts\", true)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Recurring schedules with team info\n    supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .gte(\"valid_until\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"day_of_week\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .gte(\"end_date\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n\n    // Teams for TS assignment\n    supabase\n      .from(\"teams\")\n      .select(\"id, name, year\")\n      .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n      .order(\"year\")\n      .order(\"name\"),\n\n    // Room issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(50),\n  ]);\n\n  const rooms = (roomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const schedules = (schedulesResult.data || []) as (RecurringSchedule &amp; { room: Room; team: { id: string; name: string } })[];\n  const breaks = (breaksResult.data || []) as ScheduleBreak[];\n  const teams = teamsResult.data || [];\n  const issues = (issuesResult.data || []) as (RoomIssue &amp; {\n    room?: { id: string; code: string; name: string };\n    reporter?: { id: string; full_name: string };\n    resolver?: { id: string; full_name: string };\n  })[];\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/api/rooms/[code]/quick-status/route.ts",

            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * GET /api/rooms/[code]/quick-status\n * Get quick status info for QR code scans\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try {\n    const { code } = await params;\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    \n    // Check authentication\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    // Fetch room by code\n    const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n      .single();\n\n    if (roomError || !room) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Místnost nenalezena\" },\n        { status: 404 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const now = new Date();\n    const nowIso = now.toISOString();\n\n    // Fetch current reservation\n    const { data: currentReservation } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .lte(\"start_time\", nowIso)\n      .gt(\"end_time\", nowIso)\n      .single();\n\n    // Fetch open issues\n    const { data: issues } = await supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\");\n\n    const roomIssues = (issues || []) as RoomIssue[];\n    const isLocked = roomIssues.some((i) =&gt; i.issue_type === \"locked\");\n    const otherIssues = roomIssues\n      .filter((i) =&gt; i.issue_type !== \"locked\")\n      .map((i) =&gt; {\n        const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n          mess: \"Nepořádek\",\n          technical: \"Technický problém\",\n          other: \"Jiné\",\n        };\n        return labels[i.issue_type] || i.issue_type;\n      });\n\n    // Determine status\n    let status: 'free' | 'occupied' | 'locked' = 'free';\n    if (isLocked) {\n      status = 'locked';\n    }\n}",

Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n\n    if (endTime &lt; now) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace již skončila\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if user has conflicting reservation\n    const { data: conflicts } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"id\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", profile?.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .lt(\"start_time\", reservation.end_time)\n      .gt(\"end_time\", reservation.start_time);\n\n    if (conflicts &amp;&amp; conflicts.length &gt; 0) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"V tomto čase máš jinou rezervaci\" },\n        { status: 409 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if already joined\n    const { data: existing } = await supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .select(\"id\")\n      .eq(\"reservation_id\", reservation_id)\n      .eq(\"user_id\", profile?.id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (existing) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Už jsi připojen/a k této rezervaci\" },\n        { status: 409 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Join\n    const { data: participant, error } = await supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .insert({\n        reservation_id,\n        user_id: profile?.id,\n      })\n      .select()\n      .single();\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error joining cowork:\", error);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se připojit\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: participant,\n      message: \"Připojeno ke coworku\",\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"POST /api/reservations/join error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * DELETE /api/reservations/join\n * Leave a cowork reservation\n */\nexport async function DELETE(request: NextRequest) {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "-- Tappka Reservation System Migration\n-- Creates tables for rooms, reservations, recurring schedules, cowork participants, room issues, and schedule breaks\n\n-- ============================================\n-- EXTENSIONS\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Required for EXCLUDE constraint (preventing overlapping reservations)\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;\n\n-- ============================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Reservation types\nCREATE TYPE reservation_type AS ENUM ('personal', 'training_session', 'houston_calling');\n\n-- Issue types for room problems\nCREATE TYPE issue_type AS ENUM ('locked', 'mess', 'technical', 'other');\nCREATE TYPE issue_status AS ENUM ('open', 'resolved');\n\n-- Schedule break types (Days of Joy, holidays, etc.)\nCREATE TYPE schedule_break_type AS ENUM ('days_of_joy', 'holiday', 'other');\n\n-- ============================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Rooms table\n-- Stores all reservable rooms with their rules\nCREATE TABLE rooms (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,          -- 'd126', 'd132', etc. (used in URLs)\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 'D126', 'Tichá místnost', etc.\n    description TEXT,                    -- Optional description\n    available_days INTEGER[],            -- NULL = all days, [3] = Wednesday only (0=Sun, 1=Mon, etc.)\n    can_have_ts BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,  -- Can have Training Sessions?\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Recurring schedules table\n-- Stores recurring Training Session schedules set by coaches\nCREATE TABLE recurring_schedules (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),",

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can add an index like:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate index userid\non test_table\nusing btree (user_id);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Call functions with &#96;select&#96;\n\nYou can use &#96;select&#96; statement to improve policies that use functions. For example, instead of this:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( auth.uid() = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can do:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis method works well for JWT functions like &#96;auth.uid()&#96; and &#96;auth.jwt()&#96; as well as &#96;security definer&#96; Functions. Wrapping the function causes an &#96;initPlan&#96; to be run by the Postgres optimizer, which allows it to \"cache\" the results per-statement, rather than calling the function on each row.\n\nCaution: You can only use this technique if the results of the query or function do not change based on the row data.\n\n### Minimize joins\n\nYou can often rewrite your Policies to avoid joins between the source and the target table. Instead, try to organize your policy to fetch all the relevant data from the target table into an array or set, then you can use an &#96;IN&#96; or &#96;ANY&#96; operation in your filter.\n\nFor example, this is an example of a slow policy which joins the source &#96;test_table&#96; to the target &#96;team_user&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  (select auth.uid()) in (\n    select user_id\n    from team_user\n    where team_user.team_id = team_id -- joins to the source \"test_table.team_id\"\n  )\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWe can rewrite this to avoid this join, and instead select the filter criteria into a set:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  team_id in (\n    select team_id\n    from team_user",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "using ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "You can add an index like:",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "create index userid",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "on test_table",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "using btree (user_id);",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "### Call functions with &#96;select&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 177

            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "You can use &#96;select&#96; statement to improve policies that use functions. For example, instead of this:",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "using ( auth.uid() = user_id );",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "You can do:",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "using ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "This method works well for JWT functions like &#96;auth.uid()&#96; and &#96;auth.jwt()&#96; as well as &#96;security definer&#96; Functions. Wrapping the function causes an &#96;initPlan&#96; to be run by the Postgres optimizer, which allows it to \"cache\" the results per-statement, rather than calling the function on each row.",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "Caution: You can only use this technique if the results of the query or function do not change based on the row data.",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "### Minimize joins",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "You can often rewrite your Policies to avoid joins between the source and the target table. Instead, try to organize your policy to fetch all the relevant data from the target table into an array or set, then you can use an &#96;IN&#96; or &#96;ANY&#96; operation in your filter.",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "For example, this is an example of a slow policy which joins the source &#96;test_table&#96; to the target &#96;team_user&#96;:",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "using (",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "  (select auth.uid()) in (",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "    select user_id",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "    from team_user",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "    where team_user.team_id = team_id -- joins to the source \"test_table.team_id\"",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "  )",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "We can rewrite this to avoid this join, and instead select the filter criteria into a set:",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "using (",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "  team_id in (",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "    select team_id",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "    from team_user",
            "lineNumber": 225
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.21822994947433472

        "contents": "/**\n * POST /api/reservations/join\n * Join an open cowork reservation\n */\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body: JoinRequest = await request.json();\n    const { reservation_id } = body;\n\n    if (!reservation_id) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Chybí ID rezervace\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check reservation exists and is open for cowork\n    const { data: reservation } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"id, user_id, is_cowork_open, status, start_time, end_time\")\n      .eq(\"id\", reservation_id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (!reservation) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace nenalezena\" },\n        { status: 404 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (reservation.status !== \"active\") {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace není aktivní\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (!reservation.is_cowork_open) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Tato rezervace není otevřená pro cowork\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Get current user's profile ID\n    const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase);\n    if (!profile) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Uživatelský profil nenalezen\" },\n        { status: 403 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Can't join your own reservation\n    if (reservation.user_id === profile?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nemůžeš se připojit k vlastní rezervaci\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if reservation is in the future or happening now\n    const now = new Date();\n    const endTime = new Date(reservation.end_time);\n    if (endTime &lt; now) {\n      return NextResponse.json\n\n}",

        "contents": "-- References the new users table instead of auth.users\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to automatically update updated_at column\ncreate or replace function public.handle_updated_at()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  new.updated_at := now();\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_updated_at() is 'Trigger function that automatically updates the updated_at column to the current timestamp on row updates.';\n\n-- Create trigger function to populate public.users on auth.users creation\n-- Extracts Google OAuth data from auth.users.raw_user_meta_data and auth.users.email\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_auth_user()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_google_email text;\n  v_google_full_name text;\n  v_google_profile_picture text;\n  v_raw_meta_data jsonb;\nbegin\n  v_raw_meta_data := new.raw_user_meta_data;",

          }

        "contents": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\n   - User enters code to complete verification\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\n\n## Database Schema\n\n### Tables\n\n#### &#96;profiles&#96;\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: false |\n| school_email | TEXT | Yes | Verified school email |\n| locale | TEXT | No | Preferred language ('cs', 'en'). Default: 'cs' |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Registration time |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Last update time |\n\n#### &#96;teams&#96;\nTeam companies (tymove firmy)\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Team identifier |\n| name | TEXT | No | Team name |\n| year | INTEGER | No | Cohort year (1, 2, 3) |\n| is_active | BOOLEAN | No | Still active team? Default: true |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n#### &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96;\nAdmin-imported student list from Excel\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Record identifier |\n| email | TEXT (unique) | No | School email from Excel |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | No | Assigned team |\n| role | ENUM | No | Expected role |\n| full_name | TEXT | Yes | Name from Excel (optional) |\n| claimed_by | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | Yes | User who claimed this email |\n| claimed_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Yes | When claimed |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "   - User enters code to complete verification",
            "lineNumber": 72

Podzim 2026', 'Vánoční prázdniny', etc.\n    start_date DATE NOT NULL,\n    end_date DATE NOT NULL,\n    created_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,  -- Can be NULL if creator deleted\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    \n    -- Ensure valid date range\n    CONSTRAINT valid_break_date_range CHECK (end_date &gt;= start_date)\n);\n\n-- ============================================\n-- INDEXES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Rooms\nCREATE INDEX idx_rooms_code ON rooms(code);\n\n-- Recurring schedules\nCREATE INDEX idx_recurring_schedules_room ON recurring_schedules(room_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_recurring_schedules_team ON recurring_schedules(team_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_recurring_schedules_day ON recurring_schedules(day_of_week);\nCREATE INDEX idx_recurring_schedules_valid ON recurring_schedules(valid_from, valid_until);\n\n-- Reservations\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_room_time ON reservations(room_id, start_time, end_time) WHERE status = 'active';\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_user ON reservations(user_id) WHERE status = 'active';\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_team ON reservations(team_id) WHERE status = 'active';\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_type ON reservations(reservation_type) WHERE status = 'active';\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_start ON reservations(start_time) WHERE status = 'active';",
